title: Schwinger – The Little Wrestler
yarn_note: Made with light (DK, CYC 3) yarn and a 3.0 mm hook, which is smaller than the yarn label suggests so the fabric is tight and the stuffing does not show. A thinner or thicker yarn makes the figure smaller or larger, so check your gauge first.

other: 2 pipe cleaners (optional, to stiffen the legs)

parts.name: Head and body (one piece, worked from the top of the head down)
parts.color: dark brown hair, skin tan face and chest, ivory breeches

steps.instruction: Change to skin tan: sc around (face)
(sc, dec) 6 times. Stuff the head firmly.
Change to ivory: (3 sc, inc) 6 times (hips)
sc around. Stuff the body firmly, fasten off leaving a long tail and sew the opening flat.

assembly: Sew the two legs side by side to the flat bottom of the body, so the shoes point forward.
Sew the arms to the shoulders around Rnd 16-17 of the body, letting them hang slightly away from the sides.

Open shirt: with ivory yarn, sew two vertical bands of long stitches down the chest from the shoulders to the waist, leaving the middle tan so the chest shows. Add a short ivory belt line at the waist.
Face: with black yarn, embroider two small eyes on Rnd 9. With dark brown yarn, embroider a short mustache on Rnd 11. Use tan yarn to add a small nose between them.
Sew both shoes firmly to the grass base. Dot the base with a few ochre French knots for the meadow flowers.
notes: Use a stitch marker and work in a continuous spiral. Stuff each part firmly before closing. A pipe cleaner in each leg helps the figure stand upright.
